newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistani stocks end down on blue-chip selling.
newsitem.headline: Pakistani stocks end down on blue-chip selling.

text.p: Pakistani stocks ended down on Thursday on selling of blue chips by financial institutions, dealers at the Karachi Stock Exchange said.
The Karachi 100-share index ended 5.29 points, or 0.35 percent, down at 1,507.88 amid 246 losers and 63 gainers.
Some institutions had sold blue chips, one dealer of A.G. Mohammad said.
Lever Brothers fell 5.0 rupees to 720, Adamjee Insurance 2.0 to 107 and ICP SEMF 1.20 to 50.45 at 14.08 p.m. (0908 GMT).
